name: MoYu RS3 M 3x3 V5 SE (Magnetic)
description: MoYu RS3 M 3x3 V5 SE (Magnetic) is the successor to the legendary RS3 M 2020 that took the cubing community by storm—now in a Special Edition look with a black logo and matching black packaging. The turning feel and performance are the same as the Standard version; SE is all about the cleaner, stealthier presentation.
features: Black logo for a cleaner, stealth look
Circular core design for increased stability
